records.lens: RECOMPUTE: I rebuilt the merged records from SHA-checked copies of all eight jobs' raw records and reran the registered report, joint reading, section 15 items, costs, DR0 and GLMM input with the frozen code (an export of f6144d6b on the host). I also wrote my own implementation from the raw per-episode records, importing no harness module. It covers success by size and harness, δ with its 90% t interval, X_z with the sign-flip and per-cell flip tests, D_b, X_c, π_z, π_small with its task-cluster bootstrap bounds, DR1, DR2, DR5, the D82 and flagged-task sensitivities, the S1a-base secondary set, δ per session and the pairwise session shifts. problems.issue: DR2's Near-equivalent rests on π_small's one-sided 95% upper bound, 0.118719, from the registered seed 42 at 10,000 resamples. At that resample count the seed alone moves the bound across 0.12 about 10% of the time. RESULTS disclosure 6 states the 0.0013 margin but not this dependence on the Monte Carlo seed.
problems.evidence: My own estimator code on the registered seed-42 resample indices reproduces 0.118719 and every other bound to within 5e-7. Across 20 independent seeds (1000-1019) at B = 10,000 the bound ranges from 0.1169 to 0.1211 (mean 0.1186, sd 0.0011), and 2 of the 20 are at or above 0.12, which would read Inconclusive. At B = 200,000 (seed 424242) the bound is 0.1191 and the lower bound 0.0099; 4.79% of the draws are at or above 0.12. So the registered reading is correct as registered, and the large-resample bootstrap also gives Near-equivalent. In a separate run with an independent seed, the identical corrected-verdict array gave 0.1206 (Inconclusive). DR5 NO-GO holds under every seed tried (upper bound at most 0.1211, below 0.13).
problems.fix: Add one sentence to RESULTS disclosure 6 (and the 'does not license' list): at the registered 10,000 resamples the bound's Monte Carlo sd is about 0.001, so another seed would read Inconclusive about 10% of the time; at 200,000 resamples the bound is 0.1191, below 0.12. No rule or outcome changes.

problems.issue: The secondary S1a-base reading (32 tasks; no rule reads it) also depends on the seed. Its registered π_small upper bound is 0.121 (Inconclusive), and an independent seed gave 0.118 (Near-equivalent).
problems.evidence: report.json secondary_s1a_base π_small one_sided_95 [0.0, 0.12097]; my independent-seed bootstrap gave [0.0, 0.11818]. The point estimate, the t test (p 0.895246, 90% CI [-4.60, 5.38] pp) and X p ≈ 0.37 agree.
problems.fix: Optionally note in RESULTS that the description 'Inconclusive on the 32 base tasks' is within Monte Carlo error of the line, like the primary bound.

problems.issue: The 'What the result licenses' section overstates DR2 Near-equivalent. It says 'The two certified harnesses' success rates do not differ' and 'Present is excluded by both registered tests'. The outcome paragraph says 'so no harness effect is Present'. Near-equivalent is a bounded-difference class (δ's 90% t interval within ±7.5 pp and π_small's upper bound below 0.12). A test that does not reject does not exclude an effect.
problems.evidence: RESULTS.md lines 422-425 and line 26. Registration section 13, DR2: 'Present if Holm ... rejects ...; Near-equivalent if not present, the 90% t interval ... within ±7.5 pp and the one-sided 95% upper bound of π_small is below 0.12'. RESULTS' own 'does not license' section (lines 439-444) and the label-permutation p = 0.047 show the qualification is needed.
problems.fix: Reword to: 'DR2 does not classify the pair Present (δ p = 1.000, X sign flip p = 0.093), and the difference lies within the registered margin: δ 0.00 pp, 90% t ±2.44 pp; π_small upper bound 0.1187 < 0.12.'
